summary: Full extraction of the 22 stored Greek documents. The Ministry of Migration annex tables (Dec 2021 - Aug 2026) are now extracted in full for the golden visa: family-member permits by nationality, applications by year and month filed and status, issued permits by month of decision, pending files by category, year filed and region. The 2016-2019 permit spreadsheets give golden-visa permits by nationality, office and age (sums of the data rows, matching the pivot totals). The bulletins add pending shares by nationality and calendar-year issued permits. Laws add tourism-lease, inherited-property and fee terms. Every printed table checked adds up.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; long-term lease of complex tourist accommodation (art. 8(2) Law 4002/2011) or timeshare (Law 1652/1986); North, Central and South Athens regional units, Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni, Municipality of Thessaloniki, Mykonos and Santorini
program_terms.location: art. 91 (new art. 20 B(1)(δ) and B(2)(a) Law 4251/2014)
program_terms.quote: καθώς και το συνολικό συμβατικό μίσθωμα των μισθώσεων ξενοδοχειακών καταλυμάτων ή τουριστικών κατοικιών του παρόντος, καθορίζεται σε πεντακόσιες χιλιάδες (500.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "as well as the total contractual rent of the leases of hotel accommodation or tourist residences ... is set at five hundred thousand (500,000) euros". Paid in full before applying. Re-enacted unchanged in art. 100(1)(δ) and (2)(a) Law 5038/2023 from 1.4.2023. valid_to follows the real-estate rows (old rules available until the deposit window closed on 31.8.2024 under Law 5100/2024).

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; long-term lease of complex tourist accommodation or timeshare; all other areas
program_terms.location: art. 91 (new art. 20 B(1)(δ) and B(2)(b) Law 4251/2014)
program_terms.quote: καθώς και το συνολικό συμβατικό μίσθωμα των μισθώσεων ξενοδοχειακών καταλυμάτων ή τουριστικών κατοικιών του παρόντος, καθορίζεται σε διακόσιες πενήντα χιλιάδες (250.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "... is set at two hundred fifty thousand (250,000) euros" for "the other areas of the country". Same in art. 100(2)(b) Law 5038/2023. Continues the EUR 250,000 lease route of 2013 (circular 13/2013).

program_terms.applies_to: adult who inherited the property or received it as a parental gift (objective, i.e. tax, value counts); North, Central and South Athens regional units, Vari-Voula-Vouliagmeni, Municipality of Thessaloniki, Mykonos and Santorini
program_terms.location: art. 91 (new art. 20 B(1)(ε) and B(2)(a) Law 4251/2014)
program_terms.quote: Είναι ενήλικος και απέκτησε κατά πλήρη κυριότητα και νομή ως εξ αδιαθέτου ή από διαθήκη κληρονόμος ή συνεπεία γονικής παροχής, ακίνητη περιουσία αντικειμενικής αξίας τουλάχιστον ίσης με την οριζόμενη στην υποπαρ. 2
program_terms.notes: Translation: "is an adult and acquired in full ownership, by intestate or testamentary succession or as a parental gift, real estate of an objective value at least equal to that set in sub-para. 2". The amount is the sub-para. 2 threshold for the area (EUR 500,000 here). Reading the zone threshold as applying to inherited property is ours: the law refers to sub-para. 2 without saying which tier.

program_terms.applies_to: adult who inherited the property or received it as a parental gift (objective value counts); all other areas
program_terms.location: art. 91 (new art. 20 B(1)(ε) and B(2)(b) Law 4251/2014)
program_terms.quote: Είναι ενήλικος και απέκτησε κατά πλήρη κυριότητα και νομή ως εξ αδιαθέτου ή από διαθήκη κληρονόμος ή συνεπεία γονικής παροχής, ακίνητη περιουσία αντικειμενικής αξίας τουλάχιστον ίσης με την οριζόμενη στην υποπαρ. 2
program_terms.notes: Translation as in the EUR 500,000 row; EUR 250,000 is the sub-para. 2(b) threshold for the other areas.

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; long-term lease of complex tourist accommodation or timeshare; Attica region, Thessaloniki regional unit, Mykonos, Thira and islands over 3,100 inhabitants
program_terms.quote: καθώς και το συνολικό συμβατικό μίσθωμα των συμβάσεων της περ. δ) της παρ. 1 καθορίζονται σε οκτακόσιες χιλιάδες (800.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "as well as the total contractual rent of the contracts of point (δ) of para. 1 are set at eight hundred thousand (800,000) euros". Same transitional rules as the real-estate rows (old thresholds if a 10% deposit/contract was in place by 31.8.2024).

program_terms.applies_to: main investor; long-term lease of complex tourist accommodation or timeshare; all other areas
program_terms.quote: καθώς και το συνολικό συμβατικό μίσθωμα των συμβάσεων της περ. δ) της παρ. 1 καθορίζονται σε τετρακόσιες χιλιάδες (400.000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "... are set at four hundred thousand (400,000) euros" for "the other areas of the country".

program_terms.applies_to: adult who inherited the property or received it as a parental gift (objective value counts); Attica region, Thessaloniki regional unit, Mykonos, Thira and islands over 3,100 inhabitants
program_terms.quote: Είναι ενήλικος και απέκτησε κατά πλήρη κυριότητα και νομή ως εξ αδιαθέτου ή από διαθήκη κληρονόμος ή συνεπεία γονικής παροχής, ακίνητη περιουσία αντικειμενικής αξίας τουλάχιστον ίσης με την οριζόμενη στην παρ. 2
program_terms.notes: Translation: "is an adult and acquired ... by succession or as a parental gift, real estate of an objective value at least equal to that set in para. 2". Para. 2(a) sets EUR 800,000 for these areas; reading that tier as applying to inherited property is ours (para. 2 also has EUR 250,000 tiers for conversions and listed buildings).

program_terms.applies_to: adult who inherited the property or received it as a parental gift (objective value counts); all other areas
program_terms.quote: Είναι ενήλικος και απέκτησε κατά πλήρη κυριότητα και νομή ως εξ αδιαθέτου ή από διαθήκη κληρονόμος ή συνεπεία γονικής παροχής, ακίνητη περιουσία αντικειμενικής αξίας τουλάχιστον ίσης με την οριζόμενη στην παρ. 2
program_terms.notes: Translation as in the EUR 800,000 row; EUR 400,000 is the para. 2(b) threshold for the other areas.

program_terms.applies_to: per application for the grant or renewal of a type B.5 permit (golden visa, main investor); same fee for types B.1-B.4
program_terms.quote: για τις άδειες διαμονής που περιλαμβάνονται στην κατηγορία «Β» του Μέρους Ε’ και στους τύπους αδειών διαμονής «Β.1», «Β.2», «Β.3», «Β.4» και «Β.5» του Κεφαλαίου Β’, σε δύο χιλιάδες (2000) ευρώ
program_terms.notes: Translation: "for the residence permits in category B ... and types B.1, B.2, B.3, B.4 and B.5 ..., two thousand (2000) euros". Electronic fee (παράβολο) accompanying the application for grant and renewal (art. 171(1)). Reissue of a permit costs EUR 100 (art. 171(1)(ια)); minors pay no fee (art. 171(2)(γ)). Family members get a family-reunification permit (art. 95(2), PDF p. 64); their fee is not stated for investor families specifically. Circular 13/2013 said that in 2013 these applications carried no fee.

program_terms.applies_to: application for a permit under art. 36A Law 3386/2005 (property owners and tourism leases)
program_terms.quote: Τα αιτήματα της συγκεκριμένης κατηγορίας δεν συνοδεύονται από παράβολο, καθόσον δεν υφίσταται σχετική πρόβλεψη
program_terms.notes: Translation: "Applications in this category are not accompanied by a fee, since there is no provision for one." valid_to is only the latest possible end: the stored documents show a EUR 2,000 fee from 1.4.2023 (Law 5038/2023 art. 171); a fee may have been introduced earlier (e.g. under Law 4251/2014), which was not checked.

events.title: Last day for old-rule investors to switch to another property
events.description: Under art. 64(4) Law 5100/2024 (as consolidated with Law 5167/2024), an investor who qualified for the pre-2024 thresholds (deposit or contract by 31.8.2024) but whose purchase fell through could complete the investment in another property under the old rules, but not after 30 April 2025. The consolidated text does not say whether this sentence was in the original law or added later.
events.quote: και πάντως όχι πέραν της 30ής Απριλίου 2025

new_indicators.name: Applications rejected, by year filed
new_indicators.definition: Applications filed in a period (year or month of filing) that had been rejected by the date of the source, counted by the period in which they were filed, not the period of the decision. First-time (initial) applications unless the breakdown says permit_type=renewal.
new_indicators.notes: added by extract-grc for the Greek Ministry of Migration annex tables (Πίνακας 13α/13β). Figures for recent filing periods grow as pending files are decided.

new_indicators.name: Applications withdrawn or revoked, by year filed
new_indicators.definition: Applications filed in a period that had been withdrawn or revoked ("ανακλήσεις") by the date of the source, counted by the period in which they were filed. First-time applications unless the breakdown says permit_type=renewal.
new_indicators.notes: added by extract-grc. The Greek tables do not define "ΑΝΑΚΛΗΣΕΙΣ"; it can mean withdrawal of the application or revocation of the decision.

Notes restate the old art. 20 Law 4251/2014 rules (EUR 250,000). All tables add up to their printed totals; the pending column of 13α equals Πίνακας 16. Extracted: golden-visa permits by nationality, by issuing office and by age band (sums of the data-sheet rows, each adding up to the pivot total), plus the small separate investor category ('ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΕΣ'/'ΕΠΕΝΔΥΤΗΣ', not the golden visa) from the pivot sheet. ledger.contains: Law 5007/2022 art. 91 as published by TaxHeaven (the stored copy holds art. 91 only, not the transitional art. 92 named in the title): new art. 20 B Law 4251/2014 - EUR 500,000 in parts of Athens, Thessaloniki, Mykonos, Santorini and EUR 250,000 elsewhere, for purchases, co-owned shares, company-held property, tourism leases/timeshares and inherited or gifted property (objective value); payment methods; family members; resale; no work right; two-month decision deadline. Real-estate thresholds were already in program_terms; tourism-lease and inherited-property thresholds added now.

Migration Code (116 pp.). Golden-visa relevant parts: art. 95 (five-year permits for investor categories, family members, children over 21 get a 3-year permit), art. 99 (type B.4 financial investments, minimums already in program_terms), art. 100 (type B.5 real estate, same thresholds as Law 5007/2022), art. 171 (fee: EUR 2,000 for B.1-B.5 grant or renewal, added now; EUR 100 reissue), art. 176 transitional extension of the Law 5007/2022 deposit deadline to 31.7.2023 (already in program_terms notes). Everything else (other permit types, procedure) is out of scope.

Law 5100/2024 art. 64 consolidated with Law 5167/2024: new art. 100 Law 5038/2023 - EUR 800,000 (Attica, Thessaloniki, Mykonos, Thira, large islands) / EUR 400,000 elsewhere, 120 m2 minimum, EUR 250,000 for conversions and listed buildings (already in program_terms), the same thresholds for tourism leases and inherited property (added now), short-let ban with EUR 50,000 fine and EUR 150,000 fines for listed-building breaches (in events/terms), transitional deadlines 31.8.2024, 28.2.2025 (in events) and 30.4.2025 (added as an event).

Interior Ministry circular 13/2013 on art. 36A Law 3386/2005 (Law 4146/2013): EUR 250,000 property or 10-year tourism lease, co-ownership and company rules, five-year permit, family members, renewal. EUR 250,000 terms and the launch event were already recorded; the statement that applications carried no fee is added now as a fee term.

Interior Ministry circular 15/2013: older purchases qualify if the current objective value is at least EUR 250,000 (already an event); owners by gift or parental gift qualify; company-held property must be wholly owned by an EU/Greek-seated company; the right is lost if the property is sold within five years. No further amounts.

European Commission report COM(2019) 12 on investor citizenship and residence schemes (all Member States). Greece appears only qualitatively: real-estate model with renting possible, an undefined 'strategic investment' option, presence required only on the day of application. No Greek numbers; the one Greek event is already recorded. Same document as intl-ec-com-2019-12.
